# KeystoneGrid

> A draggable, resizable dashboard grid layout library for Vue, React, and Angular — Vue ships today; React and Angular reuse the same framework-agnostic core. Zero runtime dependencies, TypeScript-first, native Pointer Events (no bundled drag library), 99%+ statement coverage.

KeystoneGrid provides two components — `GridLayout` (the container) and
`GridItem` (a single draggable/resizable cell) — for building
customizable dashboards: drag, resize, responsive breakpoints,
collision handling, undo/redo, cross-grid drag-and-drop, and more, all
built in. Only the Vue package (`@keystone-dashboard-layout/vue`) is
published; React and Angular packages are in progress and reuse the
same core positioning/collision engine (`@keystone-dashboard-layout/core`).

Paths below are relative to the site root. Every example page embeds a
live, interactive instance of the real published component.
